PATIENT INFORMATION

Website Privacy Policy

Prepared October 4, 2026 · Effective date: pending practice adoption

Draft — factual details still need confirmation. This policy cannot be finalized until the practice confirms hosting logs, service providers, retention, tracking, and how appointment submissions are handled. Bracketed review items are not adopted policies.

Scope

This policy is intended to explain information handling on the Tooth Cube Dental website. Patient health-record practices are addressed separately in our Notice of Privacy Practices.

Browsing this website

The current website’s own code does not include advertising pixels, analytics scripts, or browser-storage tracking. Its appointment check evaluates your answer in your browser without submitting that answer to the practice.

[Confirm before publication: the hosting provider’s collection of IP addresses, device or browser details, request logs, cookies, purposes, recipients, and retention periods. Confirm whether any platform features track visitors across other sites.]

Appointment requests

Appointment links take you to Carelyze. The information entered there is processed outside this website. Review the privacy information displayed by that service before submitting information.

[Confirm: the categories collected by the clinic’s Carelyze form, who receives them, how the clinic uses them, applicable agreements and safeguards, and retention. Add the verified Carelyze privacy-policy link.]

Contacting the office

If you email us, your message may include your name, email address, and any information you choose to send. Contact details are used to respond to your inquiry. Please call the office to arrange an appropriate method for sending medical records, insurance documents, or other sensitive information instead of including them in an ordinary email.
